observations: Large chest freezer with a glass lid.
The lid is open, showing a lighted interior with a grid pattern.
A single compartment is visible inside with a divider.
A sticker on the front reads 'SINCE 2018' and '220L'.
The exterior is dark grey or black.
A power cord is visible at the bottom right.
The unit appears to be in a domestic or commercial setting.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.

risks.risk: The compressor may be noisy or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the freezer running with the lid open.

risks.risk: The interior may have rust, stains, or missing parts.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the interior walls and the bottom of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: as heavily used with potential rust

risks.risk: The door seal (gasket) may be torn or leaking.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the door gasket.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the freezer running to confirm the compressor works.
Photos of the interior with the lid closed to check for rust or damage.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the back or side.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
